content: Personal calorie/macro tracker data model (community consensus, corroborated by OFF per-100g nutriments and TACO per-100g basis): foods table with per-100g macros + source flag; log entries referencing food_id + grams (+ meal type + date); targets per period; saldo computed as targets minus consumed sum on read. Snapshotting macros at log time recommended so catalog edits never rewrite history. Self-hosted references: wger, FitTrackee (existence known from training, not re-verified now).
